recommendation_summary: The reply recommends a reviewer-coverage rule to launch this week in the existing tracker. Each PR gets an available, authorized reviewer, with one of the other two qualified engineers named as backup. If the primary reviewer is absent, the review moves to the backup right away. Review standards stay the same, and the approval wait on the next six changes is measured against the current three-day wait. Squads/chapters, Jira Align and quarterly workshops are rejected and not offered as optional additions. The reply notes that the tracker was not inspected.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want changes to ship faster and stop waiting when the lead is absent.
labels.Deleted: Squads, chapters, Jira Align, and quarterly planning workshops add no mechanism needed to resolve the observed delay.
labels.Bottleneck: Approval waited three days on all six changes because the sole assigned reviewer was away; coding took less than a day.
labels.Checked myself: Your supplied facts establish that two other engineers are qualified and authorized to approve; I have not independently inspected the tracker.

note: The reply is a bounded backup-reviewer fix: all four record lines are specific and come before the recommendation, and it rejects the larger stack outright.
